verifications.claim: Bill Ackman has launched a combined IPO for Pershing Square USA, Ltd. (PSUS) and Pershing Square Inc. (PSI).
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: Bill Ackman's Pershing Square Capital Management launched the initial public offerings of Pershing Square USA (PSUS) and Pershing Square Inc. (R1); Outspoken billionaire investor Bill Ackman launched the roadshow Monday for a combined initial public offering (R3); Pershing Square Inc. (PSI)... publicly filed... relating to a proposed initial public offering... together... the Combined IPO (R4); Bill Ackman's Pershing Square kicked off a roadshow for the U.S. initial public offerings (R5)
verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources directly confirm Ackman launched or kicked off the combined IPO/roadshow for PSUS and PSI.

verifications.claim: Pershing Square USA, Ltd. (PSUS) is a new $5-$10 billion closed-end fund.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: Pershing Square USA, a new closed-end fund targeting between $5 billion and $10 billion (R3); PSUS is seeking an aggregate offering size of at least $5,000,000,000... not... in excess of $10,000,000,000 (R4); Pershing Square USA expects to raise between $5 billion and $10 billion (R5); Pershing Square USA, Ltd. (PSUS), a closed end investment company (R4, R6)
verifications.reasoning: Sources explicitly describe PSUS as a new closed-end fund targeting $5-10B.

verifications.claim: Pershing Square Inc. (PSI) is the management firm.
verifications.label: VAGUE
verifications.evidence: the management company under "PS." (R3); Pershing Square Inc. ("PSI"), the prospective parent company of PSCM (R4); PS Inc. currently expects... PS Inc. Common Stock (R6); Pershing Square Inc. (PSI), an alternative asset management company (R4)
verifications.reasoning: PSI is described as the management company or asset management company going public, but precisely it is the parent of the actual manager PSCM; broader description supports but not exact.

verifications.claim: Pershing Square Inc. (PSI) is an asset manager.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: Pershing Square Inc. (PSI), an alternative asset management company (R4); PSI, the hedge fund (R7)
verifications.reasoning: Directly stated as asset management company.

verifications.claim: The pricing for the combined IPO is set for April 28, 2026.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: pricing expected on April 28 (R3); As filed... on March 10, 2026 (R6)
verifications.reasoning: R3 states pricing expected April 28; context (filing March 2026, roadshow April) confirms 2026.

verifications.claim: PSUS shares are priced at $50 each.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: Shares... priced at $50 apiece (R3); The PSUS Shares are being offered at a price of $50.00 per PSUS Share (R4); The fund is selling shares at $50 apiece (R5); $50.00 per share (R6)

verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: investors in the PSUS IPO will receive, for no additional consideration, 20 PSI Shares for every 100 PSUS Shares purchased (R4, R6); For every 100 PSUS shares... they will receive 20 PSI shares (R7)

verifications.evidence: the closed-end fund under the ticker "PSUS" (R3); listed on the New York Stock Exchange under the symbols “PSUS“ (R4, R6); Pershing Square USA will be listed... under the symbol "PSUS" (R5)

verifications.label: CLEAR
